defects.description: Description says lean back onto one supporting arm (arm reaches BEHIND for support). Baseline shoulderFwdR:-5 (slight forward) — RIGHT arm reaches forward, not backward. RIGHT arm should be the supporting arm (reaches behind+down to ottoman surface). LEFT arm is free hand on thigh (reaches forward+down).

Description says rest the free hand on your thigh. Baseline shoulderFwdL:+7 (slight backward) — LEFT arm reaches backward, not forward to thigh. LEFT wrist at z=-0.172 (behind body), but thigh is forward (z=0 to 0.347).

failing_tests.assertion: supporting (right) arm should reach BEHIND body (wrist z < -0.05)
free (left) hand should be on thigh area (wrist z between 0.10 and 0.30, y near 0)

regression_risk: low — two-field sign/direction correction; verified geometry matches description; no flags
rationale: Real defects: (1) RIGHT arm (supporting) reaches forward instead of behind — shoulderFwdR:-5→+30. Per actual renderer convention (empirically verified), POSITIVE shoulderFwdR moves RIGHT wrist BEHIND body when shoulder in default abduction. Verified: rightWrist.z=+0.142 → -0.068 (behind body), supporting the reclined torso. (2) LEFT arm (free hand) reaches behind instead of forward to thigh — shoulderFwdL:+7→-50. NEGATIVE shoulderFwdL moves LEFT wrist FORWARD (verified). Verified: leftWrist.z=-0.172 → +0.179 (forward, at mid-thigh area between hip z=0 and knee z=0.347), leftWrist.y=+0.235 → -0.126 (drops to thigh level). Two-field minimal change; elbows already soft (30°) per description. No anomalies/plausibility flags.
